title: Short Rest in room 1.4
headline: An hour by the S door of room 1.4: Arcane Recovery brings back Magic Missile before the last door.

bullets.label: Why rest at full HP
bullets.text: the iron-bound N door is the last one on the floor, and whatever is behind it now has a warning from the goblin that fled. Magic Missile never misses, which is what he wants against something armoured.

bullets.label: Arcane Recovery
bullets.text: used: Magic Missile back (1 level of the 2 he may regain). Hit Dice stay at 1/3.

bullets.label: The purse habit
bullets.text: the 15 GP from the floor so far go on the floor by the S door of room 1.4, so a death behind the next door costs nothing.
